unfold SwapSimultaneous SwapSimultaneous_postcond
  have h_main : SwapSimultaneous_postcond (X) (Y) (SwapSimultaneous (X) (Y) h_precond) h_precond := by
    simp [SwapSimultaneous, SwapSimultaneous_postcond]
    <;>
    (try
      simp_all)
    <;>
    (try
      aesop)
    <;>
    (try
      {
        by_cases h : X = Y <;>
        simp_all [ne_eq, Ne]
        <;>
        aesop
      })
    <;>
    (try
      aesop)
    <;>
    (try
      {
        by_cases h : X = Y <;>
        simp_all [ne_eq, Ne]
        <;>
        aesop
      })
    <;>
    (try
      aesop)
  exact h_main
